description: Deletion manifest: one record per deleted or moved file. canonicalPath is the file that replaces it (null: nothing does). legacyResolverSupported / externalUrlSupported: old saved data (settings, profiles, cloud configs, replays, installed copies) / old public URLs are resolved at the point of use. legacyResolverNeeded / externalUrlNeeded: false only when the evidence in verification shows no saved data and no outside user can hold the path. approvedForDeletion is true only when internalReferencesMigrated, (legacyResolverSupported or not legacyResolverNeeded) and (externalUrlSupported or not externalUrlNeeded) all hold; a record still false keeps its file in the tree (developers/tests/manifestrefs.js checks both).
